text.description_html:
RK International CK-4445, Retro Two-Toned Square Cabinet Knob

This two-toned cabinet knob is a perfect way to show off your retro style. Whether you use it in the kitchen, the bathroom, or on any small drawer or door in your home, this 1-1/4 inch square chrome and brass cabinet pull will look great.

Also Available: Matching Deco Two-Toned Cabinet Pull

Specifications and Features of the RK International CK-4445 Retro Chrome Cabinet Knob:

  • Length: 1-1/4" square
  • Material: brass
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
